court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
respondents: Vishnu Priya, Revenue Divisional Officer … Contemnor(s).
advocates: For Contemnor(s): Mr. E. Vijay Anand Additional Government Pleader
prayer: PRAYER: Petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act to punish the respondent for her deliberate and willful disobedience of the order passed by this court on 28-4-2018 in W.P. No. 11226 of 2018.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— Alleging willful disobedience of the order dated 28-4-2018 passed by this court in W.P. No. 11226 of 2018, this contempt petition is filed.

2. When the matter was taken up for hearing, learned Additional Government Pleader filed a status report dated 10-3-2026 of the respondent, wherein it is categorically stated that the encroachment by means of pathway was removed by the Tahsildar, Vridhachalam in the presence of the Block Development Officer, Kammapuram on 24-2-2026 and the canal poramboke land were restored to its original position as “Channel Poramboke”. The learned Additional Government Pleader submitted that the order of this court has been complied with.

3. In view of the said statement made on affidavit, we do not intend to keep this contempt petition pending and the same is, accordingly, closed. There shall be no order as to costs.
